name: harness
description: Profile-driven agent runtime with guarded tools, durable runs, multi-profile orchestration, and terminal or web control surfaces.

scripts.build:bin: bun build src/server/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/harness-server --target bun && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/harness --target bun && bun build src/server/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/harness-server-linux-x64 --target bun-linux-x64 && bun build src/server/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/harness-server-macos-arm64 --target bun-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/server/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/harness-server-macos-x64 --target bun-darwin-x64 && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/harness-linux-x64 --target bun-linux-x64 && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/harness-macos-arm64 --target bun-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/cli/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/harness-macos-x64 --target bun-darwin-x64 && node scripts/build-tui.mjs
scripts.install:global: mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp bin/harness bin/harness-server bin/harness-tui ~/.local/bin/ && echo 'Installed to ~/.local/bin — ensure ~/.local/bin is in your PATH'
